name: Tsubasa no Uta
source:
A beautiful angel Rutiel suddenly appears before the main character. She confesses that she is expelled from Heavens for losing her wings. The search does not bear fruits, so they decide to  live together for the time being. A sick younger sister and a mischievous devil girl will keep them company.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
美丽的天使露蒂尔突然出现在主角面前。她承认自己因失去翅膀而被逐出天堂。寻找没有结果，他们决定暂时同居。生病的妹妹和顽皮的恶魔女孩将陪伴他们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
